lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern of approximately five horizontal rows extending posteriorly from the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that align with columns of spots, creating a grid-like nodal structure across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature in the upper third of the flank characterized by a high-intensity top edge and a defined shadow gradient immediately below.
